mapper.sql:
FROM community_items c LEFT JOIN items i ON i.goods_id = c.goods_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT MIN(item_id) AS item_id, goods_id, activity_id FROM community_activity_item GROUP BY activity_id, goods_id ) t ON c.goods_id = t.goods_id LEFT JOIN community_activity a ON t.activity_id = a.activity_id
mapper.select:
SELECT i.*, c.min_delivery_num, c.sort AS community_item_sort
ORDER BY i.item_id DESC
